concerns.location: spec.md:FR-008 vs tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage
concerns.text: FR-008 requires ingesting at least 10 public datasets from UCI and OpenML, but the plan's Scale/Scope names only two verified datasets (HAR, Shopper) and no task in this document (preserved or new) establishes selection/verification/ingestion of the remaining datasets to reach the FR-008 minimum. The coverage map lists 'FR-008/FR-009: T024–T039, T051–T066 (done)' without addressing the count. An implementer cannot satisfy FR-008 from these tasks.

SC-002 requires statistical power to be measured against the known effect-size ground truth established in the generator for the given sample size. T103 computes power, and T107's validity report covers SC-004/SC-005 error-rate deviation, but no task compares measured power against the effect-size ground truth (e.g., a power-vs-effect-size table or theoretical power reference). SC-002 has no matching verification step.

T101 depends on 'validate_seed_config (T005e)', but T005e is not listed anywhere in the preserved-work inventory (only T004–T007, T005b via redo). If T005e exists in prior work it should be listed; if not, its implementation is uncovered. Either way the reference is stale/unresolvable from this document.
